verdict.stance: Constructive / Lion Finance (BGEO)-Owned #1 Armenian Bank (Ba3 / BB-)
verdict.summary: Ameriabank (acquired by Lion Finance Group / Bank of Georgia in 2024) is Armenia's largest commercial bank with AMD 2,335bn assets, AMD 72.6bn FY25 net profit (+21% YoY), 25.0% ROE, and low 2.1% Stage 3 NPLs. Debut $100m AT1 issuance in 2026 lifted Total CAR to 17.9% above CBA's 16.75% threshold.

positives: Market-leading #1 Armenian franchise delivering 25.0% ROE and +21% YoY FY25 profit growth (AMD 72.6bn).
Low 2.1% Stage 3 NPL ratio and strong risk governance under Lion Finance (BGEO) ownership.
$100m debut AT1 bolstered Total CAR to 17.9% in 2026 above 16.75% regulatory minimum.
negatives: High ~22% loan growth creates seasoning risk as Armenia's post-2022 remittance/FX boom normalizes.
Sovereign rating ceiling (Armenia Ba3/BB-) and regional South Caucasus geopolitical risk.
Tight ~115 bps Total CAR headroom above CBA's 16.75% all-in buffer requirement.
